name: Cyrus
summary: A king of Persia whose spirit the LORD moved to send the people of Judah home. He commanded that the house of the LORD in Jerusalem be built again and gave back the vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken from it.

key_moments.title: Proclaims the Building of God's House
key_moments.description: In his first year, the LORD moved the spirit of Cyrus to send out a written proclamation through his whole kingdom. It said the LORD had charged him to build Him a house in Jerusalem, and anyone of His people could go up to build it.

key_moments.title: Returns the Temple Vessels
key_moments.description: Cyrus brought out the vessels from the LORD's house that Nebuchadnezzar had carried off from Jerusalem. They were counted out to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah, and carried back to Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Called the LORD's Shepherd
key_moments.description: The LORD called Cyrus His shepherd and His anointed, who would do all He pleased. He would say of Jerusalem that it would be built, and of the temple that its foundation would be laid.
